legalPrivacyHubIntro: Review the documents and plain-language summaries that explain how Fitaly handles your account, data, and AI features.

privacyPolicySubtitle: Read the full policy that applies to the app today.
termsOfServiceSubtitle: Open the current terms in your browser.
dataAiClaritySubtitle: See a plain-language summary of what data the app uses and where AI is involved.
dataAiClarityOverviewBody: Data you add, where AI appears, and where full legal documents live.
dataAiClarityAddedDataSummary: Profile, meals, and photos you choose to save or analyze.
dataAiClarityAddedDataDetailIntro: Fitaly works from the account, profile, and meal information you provide in the app.
dataAiClarityAddedDataAccountBody: Email address, username, health profile fields, nutrition goal, and preferences you enter.
dataAiClarityAddedDataMealsBody: Meal history, nutrition entries, saved meals, and photos you upload for logging or analysis.
dataAiClarityAiUseSummary: Photo analysis, text logging, and chat.
dataAiClarityAiUseDetailIntro: AI is used for specific actions you start. It supports logging and guidance; it is not a background monitoring system.
dataAiClarityAiUseDetailProvider: Requests go through Fitaly’s backend to the configured model provider for the feature you requested.
dataAiClarityAiUsePhotoBody: Meal photos can be analyzed to estimate ingredients and nutrition values.
dataAiClarityAiUseTextBody: Meal descriptions and nutrition questions can use relevant account or meal context to generate a response.
dataAiClarityAccountRecordSummary: Meals, profile, preferences, and account history remain saved.
dataAiClarityAccountRecordDetailIntro: Fitaly keeps the data needed to run your account, restore your history, and sync your app experience.
dataAiClarityAccountRecordStoredBody: Meal history, saved meals, profile settings, subscription-related state, and app preferences.
dataAiClarityAccountRecordAnalyticsBody: Firebase supports authentication, database storage, analytics, and app reliability.
dataAiClarityControlsShortSummary: Data export, settings, and account deletion stay in your control.
dataAiClarityControlsDetailIntro: These controls do not change in this screen. It only explains where to find them.
dataAiClarityControlsExportBody: You can export a copy of your account data from Legal & privacy.
dataAiClarityControlsDeleteBody: You can permanently delete your account and saved data from the account area.
dataAiClarityLegalDocsSummary: Open the full Privacy Policy and Terms.
dataAiClarityLegalDocsDetailIntro: This screen is a practical summary. The full documents remain the source for legal wording, rights, safeguards, and contact details.

Premium: Automatic, unlimited backup of all meals and settings. Restore your full history on any device.
Free: Limited backup and restore.

Premium: Browse and analyze your entire history with advanced filters and time ranges.
Free: Access limited to the last 30 days.

Premium: Try upcoming features and tools before anyone else. Exclusive early access for premium members!
Free: New features become available after official release and some of them will never be able for free users.
